sentences.text:
For the Petitioner : Mr. Indrajit Sinha, Advocate For the State : Mr. Prabhu Dayal Agrawal, Spl.
A.P.P. ...........
02/Dated: 26/07/2022

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is not manufacturer or packer rather he is only seller and sub-section 3 of Section 27 of the Food, Safety and Standard Act, 2006 petitioner is not liable to be prosecuted.
He further submits that the case of the petitioner is fully covered with the Cr.M.P. No. 1249 of 2014 decided on 05.05.2016.
Let notice be issued upon the O.P. No. 2 under registered cover with A/D as well as by ordinary process for which requisites etc. must be filed within two weeks.

No coercive step shall be taken against the petitioner in connection with Complaint (O.C.R.) Case No. 664 of 2020, pending in the Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dumka, till the next date.

( Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.) Satyarthi/
